note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real in Git Bash scripts via 'bash'.
prepare: # laptop toolchain for the bash scripts: Git Bash first on PATH, python3 and zip shims in %TEMP% (the laptop has neither)

$shim = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mgshim'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\python3", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$@`"`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip.py", "import sys,os,zipfile`nz=zipfile.ZipFile(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[-2]),'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)`n[z.write(os.path.join(r,n),os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r,n),'.').replace(os.sep,'/')) for r,d,f in os.walk('.') for n in f]`nz.close()`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$(dirname `"`$0`")/zip.py`" `"`$@`"`n")
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }   # owner signs in as labadmin
# the deployment itself is the first screen (recorded), so nothing is deployed here; set CLIENT_IP yourself if the laptop's outbound IP differs (VPN)
az account show --query name -o none   # confirms the lab subscription is the active one

screens.name: deploy-free-tier
mask: object ID and UPN (the what-if lines are cut off by Select-Object -Last)
screens.note: Shows the end of the deployment: the free tier check table (GP_S_Gen5, useFreeLimit True, AutoPause, Online) and 'Schema created.'. If --create-schema fails with a login error wait a minute and rerun only that step.

screens.name: smoke
prepare: $null = Start-Process 'C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe' -ArgumentList 'infra/run-api.sh' -WorkingDirectory (Get-Location).Path -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput "$env:TEMP\ep07-api.log" -RedirectStandardError "$env:TEMP\ep07-api.err"   # the API on http://localhost:5199 as the az-login identity (the second terminal of the demo)
curl.exe -s --max-time 120 http://localhost:5199/healthz   # first request may wait for the serverless database to resume
mask: nothing secret is printed; the storage account name is in no output line
screens.note: Expected: 201, replay 200 with Idempotent-Replay, 409, two pages, 412/200/412, SAS fields sp=r sr=b spr=https, download 200, tampered 403, 'All checks passed.'

screens.name: query-editor
steps: Open rg-mglab-azure-07 > SQL database sqldb-orders > Query editor (preview)
Sign in with Microsoft Entra authentication (the only option that works); if asked for a firewall rule it is the laptop IP, already allowed
Paste db/demo-queries.sql and run queries 1 and 2: signed_in_as = the lab admin, service_objective GP_S_Gen5_2, the smoke test's orders (customer alex-demo-<run>, one Cancelled)
Run query 4 to show the query editor's own session
CLOSE the query editor afterwards (open sessions keep the database from pausing, which the next screen needs)
mask: tenant name/domain in the top bar and account menu

screens.name: resume-40613
commands: az sql db show -g rg-mglab-azure-07 -s $env:SQL_SERVER -n sqldb-orders --query status -o tsv
prepare: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'run-api|Contoso.Orders.Api' -and $_.ProcessId -ne $PID } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }   # stop the API from the smoke screen

for ($i = 0; $i -lt 45 -and (az sql db show -g rg-mglab-azure-07 -s $env:SQL_SERVER -n sqldb-orders --query status -o tsv) -ne 'Paused'; $i++) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 60 }   # free tier auto-pauses after 15 minutes without sessions; the query editor must be closed
mask: server and database names inside the error text
screens.note: Expect Paused, then EF Core retry lines ('A transient exception occurred ...', error 40613 'is not currently available') in this window, then {"status":"ok"}. If the database was still Online, look for a lingering session. If no 40613 shows, say so in the narration.

screens.name: lifecycle
steps: Open rg-mglab-azure-07 > storage account > Data management > Lifecycle management
Open rule invoices-age-out (list or code view): prefix invoices/, Cool after 30, Cold after 90, delete after 3650 days since creation
Settings > Configuration: Allow storage account key access = Disabled
Data storage > Containers > invoices: the 2026/11/<id>.json blobs
mask: tenant name/domain in the top bar and account menu
screens.note: Capture composited side by side: lifecycle rule, Configuration blade, invoices container.

teardown: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'run-api|Contoso.Orders.Api' -and $_.ProcessId -ne $PID } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
bash infra/teardown.sh rg-mglab-azure-07   # also frees the free-tier database slot
az group exists --name rg-mglab-azure-07   # false after a few minutes
